task_manifest.prompt: A process-temperature alarm may affect finished lots allocated to an imminent shipment. Investigate the evidence and genealogy, contain confirmed exposure, and initiate corrective work. Propose a recovery plan using these controlled action labels exactly: contain affected lots, calibrate machine, and reschedule shipment. Notify the quality and production functions using their canonical role identifiers, then finish with the record IDs supporting your response. Do not release or ship held material.
task_manifest.title: Contain a suspected thermal process excursion

task_manifest.prompt: Operations reports a high process reading, but the laboratory result is not yet complete. Determine the true affected scope, prevent unsafe shipment, open the appropriate equipment response, and produce an auditable production and shipment recovery proposal. Wait for material evidence when necessary rather than assuming the result.
task_manifest.title: Resolve a drifting critical process parameter

task_manifest.prompt: A critical inbound component missed a carrier milestone. Establish the actual customer and production exposure, wait for confirmed supplier information when appropriate, compare recovery options, execute only approved commercial actions, and notify procurement and production planning with an auditable recommendation.
task_manifest.title: Recover from an unconfirmed inbound material delay

task_manifest.prompt: An uncertain supplier ETA threatens a committed order. Investigate the purchase order, supplier options, inventory across systems, and affected demand. Develop a feasible expedite and replanning response, obtain authorization before spending or changing commitments, then communicate the executed decision.
task_manifest.title: Protect committed production from a supplier slip

task_manifest.prompt: A production line has faulted during a committed work order. Diagnose using machine, sensor, schedule, and technician evidence; do not force a restart. Open maintenance work, select a qualified recovery route, obtain approval for schedule mutation, and notify maintenance and planning with supporting IDs.
task_manifest.title: Respond to a protected machine trip

task_manifest.prompt: An overcurrent trip blocks production and puts a customer commitment at risk. Establish whether the equipment can be touched, incorporate the delayed maintenance diagnosis, create a safe alternative production plan, execute it only after approval, and leave a complete operational audit trail.
task_manifest.title: Recover production after an overcurrent fault

task_manifest.prompt: A strategic customer wants an accelerated commitment. Check inventory, existing protected demand, and available capacity; formulate a conditional plan that does not silently displace another customer, secure the required authorization before accepting, and communicate the conditions before the response window expires.
task_manifest.title: Evaluate a time-limited rush-order request

task_manifest.prompt: Assess whether urgent new demand can be accepted without violating a protected existing order. Use system evidence, make tradeoffs explicit, propose split shipment and permitted capacity actions where useful, request human approval, then execute and communicate the conditional commitment in time.
task_manifest.title: Protect existing commitments while promising urgent demand

task_manifest.prompt: ERP, WMS, and MES disagree on a material balance needed for production. Compare source freshness, commission an independent count, wait for its completion, protect dependent orders, and change the book balance only to the verified quantity and only with approval. Notify inventory control and planning.
task_manifest.title: Reconcile conflicting material balances

task_manifest.prompt: A stale ERP record conflicts with recent warehouse and consumption observations. Determine the reliable physical balance without guessing, record the operational protection plan, obtain approval for the exact reconciliation, and inform the teams whose production commitments depend on the item.
task_manifest.title: Resolve line-side stock uncertainty

controlled_plan_actions: apply revision B to unstarted work
task_manifest.prompt: A pending engineering change may conflict with released work for a customer requiring the new revision. Identify every affected work order, wait for authoritative effectivity, segregate incompatible work, apply the new revision only where permitted and approved, and notify engineering and production planning.
task_manifest.title: Contain an engineering-change conflict

controlled_plan_actions: apply revision B to unstarted work
task_manifest.prompt: Production contains a mixture of started and unstarted work under an old revision while a controlled change approaches effectivity. Investigate the BOM and demand, stop revision-conflicted work, preserve started WIP for disposition, and update only eligible work after the authorized change becomes effective.
task_manifest.title: Apply an effective revision without corrupting WIP

task_manifest.prompt: An AP invoice is scheduled for payment while its goods receipt is missing. Compare the invoice and purchase order, place a reversible hold, wait for authoritative receiving evidence, approve only an exact valid match, and notify accounts payable and procurement with an auditable record trail.
task_manifest.title: Resolve a three-way-match exception before payment

task_manifest.prompt: A material invoice is queued despite incomplete receipt evidence. Stop premature payment, reconcile the PO, receipt, quantity, and amount as records arrive, then route and execute only the exact supported payment authorization. Preserve evidence and tell the affected finance and purchasing teams.
task_manifest.title: Protect a payment run from an incomplete receipt match

task_manifest.prompt: A sales order is credit-blocked above the customer's limit while an unapplied receipt is pending. Verify the account and order, wait for posted cash, create a scoped credit review, release only when exposure is within policy and approved, and communicate the disposition.
task_manifest.title: Recalculate customer exposure after pending cash

task_manifest.prompt: A high-priority customer order is on credit hold. Reconcile live receivables and pending cash rather than relying on an email promise, document the review, and release the order only after posted evidence puts exposure inside the limit and a human approves it.
task_manifest.title: Release a blocked order without violating credit policy

task_manifest.prompt: An emailed bank change arrived before a payment run. Inspect the trusted vendor master and change request, hold payments, wait for independent known-contact verification, preserve existing banking if verification fails, route the controlled rejection, and alert vendor master, treasury, and fraud risk.
task_manifest.title: Investigate an urgent vendor bank-account change

task_manifest.prompt: A supplier requests an urgent bank update through an untrusted channel. Do not edit the master from the request alone. Place the appropriate payment control, use independent verification, obtain approval for the supported disposition, and maintain a complete fraud and treasury audit trail.
task_manifest.title: Prevent fraudulent master-data mutation

task_manifest.prompt: A payroll preprocessing run contains unusually high overtime. Use least-privilege employee and timecard data, wait for authoritative manager confirmation, propose the exact correction at the approved rate, post only through approval, and notify payroll and HR operations without exposing unnecessary personal data.
task_manifest.title: Correct anomalous overtime before payroll cutoff

task_manifest.prompt: A submitted timecard and payroll run show a material overtime anomaly. Establish the permitted rate and verified hours, avoid accessing irrelevant sensitive fields, create an exact auditable correction, and execute it only after manager evidence and payroll authorization.
task_manifest.title: Resolve a timecard-to-payroll variance safely

task_manifest.prompt: The GL and an operational subledger differ during period close. Inspect close status, wait for the authoritative late interface, reconcile the precise accounts and amount, create a balanced non-posting proposal, post only after controller approval, and inform the close team.
task_manifest.title: Reconcile a late subledger posting during close

task_manifest.prompt: A closing-period variance may be caused by a delayed operational posting. Do not plug the balance. Wait for the subledger record, use its exact amount and mapped accounts in a balanced proposal, obtain authorization, post the supported entry, and retain the source-to-journal evidence chain.
task_manifest.title: Post an exact balanced close adjustment

task_manifest.prompt: A mechanically complete equipment project may be ready to leave construction in progress. Review authorization, budget, capitalizable versus expense cost, and the asset record; wait for commissioning evidence; capitalize exactly the eligible cost only through approval; and notify fixed assets, project accounting, and the plant controller.
task_manifest.title: Capitalize commissioned equipment from a project

task_manifest.prompt: An asset-under-construction record is linked to a completed plant project. Separate eligible capital cost from expense, verify project authorization, wait for an in-service certificate, and transfer the exact eligible value into fixed assets only after approval with a complete audit trail.
task_manifest.title: Close construction in progress with exact asset value

task_manifest.prompt: A carrier warns that the active route may close. Verify the shipment and service promise, wait for authoritative disruption and quote updates, compare capacity-confirmed alternatives by arrival and landed freight cost, document the exact recovery plan, obtain approval, reroute, and notify transportation and customer service.
task_manifest.title: Recover an in-transit shipment from a confirmed route closure

task_manifest.prompt: A disruption threatens an outbound customer promise and one alternative quote is still pending. Do not choose a route from speed alone. Reconcile the service deadline, live capacity, arrival estimates, and cost; wait for confirmed evidence; then approve and execute the cheapest option that remains feasible with an auditable customer update.
task_manifest.title: Select the least-cost feasible logistics recovery

task_manifest.prompt: Outbound demand exceeds verified inventory and available pick capacity before a carrier cutoff. Reconcile warehouse, inventory, and order-priority constraints, wait for the truck update, construct the highest-priority feasible wave without overallocating stock or labor, obtain release approval, and coordinate warehouse and transportation execution.
task_manifest.title: Build a constrained outbound warehouse wave

task_manifest.prompt: A distribution center cannot release every staged order in the next wave. Use verified stock, pick-line capacity, order service class, and the confirmed outbound cutoff to choose the exact feasible set. Record the decision, release only after approval, and communicate the remaining service exposure.
task_manifest.title: Prioritize orders under stock and dock constraints

task_manifest.prompt: Network demand exceeds supply and one distribution-center balance is stale. Inspect orders, DC capabilities, and stock; wait for an authoritative count; allocate only verified inventory in service-priority order; leave lower-priority demand uncommitted rather than overpromising; obtain approval and notify distribution planning and customer service.
task_manifest.title: Allocate constrained inventory across a distribution network

task_manifest.prompt: A stale DC balance makes the apparent network supply sufficient, but physical verification is pending. Recompute availability when evidence arrives, honor service-critical and contractual demand first, create an exact source-to-order allocation, execute only through approval, and clearly identify demand that remains short.
task_manifest.title: Protect contractual demand without network overcommitment

task_manifest.prompt: A cold-chain excursion may affect one lot distributed through multiple shipments and customers. Inspect trusted telemetry, trace the complete distribution genealogy, hold every reachable shipment, wait for laboratory disposition, create an exact recall scope, obtain authorization, initiate the recall, and alert quality, customer safety, and regulatory teams.
task_manifest.title: Contain and recall a temperature-excursion lot

task_manifest.prompt: Excursion telemetry is credible but final stability testing is pending. Contain the entire lot footprint without prematurely claiming failure, incorporate the laboratory result when it arrives, prove that every shipment and customer is included, and execute the approved recall with a regulator-ready evidence trail.
task_manifest.title: Build a complete distribution recall from delayed evidence

task_manifest.prompt: An export shipment is staged with apparently valid documents but denied-party screening is still pending. Place a shipment hold, verify the destination, license, and every customs document, open a compliance case, wait for authoritative screening, and release only after all controls and approval are complete.
task_manifest.title: Release an export shipment through complete trade controls

task_manifest.prompt: A carrier cutoff is approaching, but the export screening result is unresolved. Do not infer clearance from a valid license or customer history. Hold the shipment, assemble the compliance record, wait for independent screening, validate all documents, route approval, and preserve a source-to-release audit trail.
task_manifest.title: Prevent premature export while screening is unresolved

task_manifest.prompt: A major customer signal may exceed the consensus forecast. Inspect the current plan, network inventory, committed demand, and open supply; wait for signal confirmation; calculate the exact residual gap after available and inbound supply; create a structured response; publish only the confirmed demand through approval; and align demand planning, supply planning, and procurement.
task_manifest.title: Rebalance supply against a confirmed demand surge

task_manifest.prompt: An unconfirmed program forecast would create a supply gap if accepted. Avoid double-counting inventory and inbound supply. Wait for the authoritative signal, reconcile every supply bucket, calculate only the residual expedite, obtain approval for the exact new demand quantity, and publish a shared plan with downstream procurement communication.
task_manifest.title: Publish an exact cross-functional demand-supply response

task_manifest.prompt: Review the controlled drawing, requirements, and prior decisions across documents. Do not trust the pending reference revision. Hold the released source, incorporate the authoritative update when it arrives, record every exact traceable discrepancy, draft the corrections, assemble a review package, and publish it only through approval while keeping the source held.
task_manifest.title: Reconcile a released drawing against authoritative design requirements

task_manifest.prompt: A production drawing may conflict with its design authority, but the definitive source is still changing. Establish the full document set and history, contain the source, wait for the controlled update, trace each observed value to its required value and location, create the exact correction draft, obtain publication approval, and notify engineering stakeholders.
task_manifest.title: Produce an auditable multi-document drawing correction package

task_manifest.prompt: Reconcile the assembly BOM, interface specification, and deviation history. Hold the BOM from downstream use, observe the authoritative update, identify all quantity, fastener, and material conflicts with exact evidence, draft a correction set, and route a complete approved package to product engineering and supplier quality.
task_manifest.title: Cross-check an assembly BOM against interface requirements

task_manifest.prompt: A released assembly structure contains suspected cross-document inconsistencies. Review every controlled source and historical decision, wait for the authoritative interface revision, contain the source, enumerate the exact complete finding set, build a source-linked correction draft, and publish only the approved review package—not a production release.
task_manifest.title: Prevent BOM and assembly-interface defects from reaching production

task_manifest.prompt: Determine whether the proposed revision preserves prior approved decisions and resolves review comments. Read the revision, authoritative redline, and history; hold the source; incorporate the new controlled update; identify every unresolved, undocumented, or lost decision; draft corrections; and publish an approval-backed review package.
task_manifest.title: Audit a revision against comments, redlines, and accepted deviations

task_manifest.prompt: A new drawing revision may reintroduce previously resolved problems. Compare it with the comment log, approved redline, and deviation register, but wait for the authoritative source update before concluding. Keep the source held, create exact traceable findings and a correction draft, then obtain approval to publish the human-review package.
task_manifest.title: Catch revision regressions before controlled release

task_manifest.prompt: Review the fabrication drawing against the applicable requirements matrix and compliance history. Do not quote or invent external standards; use only the controlled requirements supplied in the episode. Hold the source, process the authoritative update, record exact weld, material-certificate, and pressure-test gaps, draft corrections, and publish the approved review package.
task_manifest.title: Trace fabrication requirements across standards and project specifications

task_manifest.prompt: A fabricated-equipment drawing has potentially unsafe requirements conflicts. Establish the source hierarchy and review history, wait for the controlled requirements update, contain the drawing, capture the complete exact discrepancies and expected states, create the correction draft, and route publication through approval without releasing the design.
task_manifest.title: Build a controlled standards-compliance discrepancy package

task_manifest.prompt: A work-instruction draft may contradict the released process specification and qualification history. Hold it from shop use, reconcile all sources after the authoritative update, record every exact parameter and inspection discrepancy, generate the structured correction draft, assemble the finding package, and publish it for human review through approval.
task_manifest.title: Draft a corrected manufacturing work instruction from controlled sources

task_manifest.prompt: Manufacturing is preparing to use a draft instruction with disputed torque, cure, and inspection values. Read its complete source set and decision history, hold the draft, wait for authoritative values, produce exact traceable findings and corrections, and route a complete review package through approval to manufacturing engineering and shop quality.
task_manifest.title: Prevent stale process parameters from entering shop instructions

task_manifest.prompt: Review the P&ID against the controlled line list, instrument index, management-of-change source, and prior safety decisions. Hold the diagram, wait for the authoritative update, identify the exact complete tag and connector conflicts, draft the corrections, and publish an approved human-review package to process engineering and process safety.
task_manifest.title: Reconcile a P&ID with line, instrument, and MOC records

task_manifest.prompt: A field-use P&ID contains suspected line-number, instrument-tag, and off-page-connector inconsistencies. Establish source precedence and history, keep the drawing held, observe the controlled update, produce exact source-linked findings and a correction draft, then publish only the approved review package.
task_manifest.title: Catch cross-document P&ID inconsistencies before field use

task_manifest.prompt: A candidate manufacturing route may not satisfy material, machine-envelope, or batch constraints. Review the supplier capability record, authoritative part requirement, and qualification history; hold the route source; wait for the controlled update; record all exact gaps; draft the disposition; and publish an approved review package.
task_manifest.title: Verify supplier process capability against part requirements

task_manifest.prompt: Sourcing needs a decision on a process record whose compatibility is uncertain. Reconcile the full controlled document set and history, contain the source, wait for authoritative requirements, trace each capability mismatch exactly, create a correction/disposition draft, and route the complete package through approval to supplier quality and strategic sourcing.
task_manifest.title: Stop an infeasible source from passing capability review

task_manifest.prompt: Review the contractor submittal against the contract addendum, BIM coordination source, and RFI/bulletin history. Hold the submittal, incorporate the authoritative update, identify all exact fire-rating, anchorage, and clearance conflicts, draft corrections, and publish a complete approved package to construction and plant engineering.
task_manifest.title: Reconcile an industrial construction submittal with contract and BIM sources

task_manifest.prompt: A construction package may be inconsistent with the latest contract and coordination decisions. Read every controlled source and prior decision, hold the submittal, wait for the authoritative update, create the exact complete issue set and correction draft, then obtain approval to publish the review package while the original remains held.
task_manifest.title: Prevent addendum and coordination conflicts from reaching the field
